title: Associativity of the fixed normalized tensor comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. Work on its small pro-etale site with independent object, arrow and coefficient universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Write $A$ for the completed integral coefficient sheaf and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of actual coefficient sequence-site modules and finite coefficient modules, with exact evaluation $e_n$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and their closed tensor structures [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Fix reduction data $R$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], with representative normalizations as specified in [lem-coef-normalized-reduction-models]. Assume tensor coherence $h_T$ and reduction and finite tensor normalizations $h_R,h_F$. Then $R.\mathrm{reductionTensor}$ and each $R.\mathrm{finiteTensor}(n)$ satisfy the inverse-comparison associativity equation. Explicitly, for the corresponding functor $F$, comparison $\mu:F(P\otimes Q)\cong FP\otimes FQ$, and source and target associators $a_S,a_T$, one has $(\mu_{P,Q}^{-1}\otimes 1)\,\mu_{P\otimes Q,V}^{-1}\,F(a_S) = a_T\,(1\otimes\mu_{Q,V}^{-1})\,\mu_{P,Q\otimes V}^{-1}$, with composition read left to right. This holds for arbitrary derived inputs $P,Q,V$. It is a tensor assertion with no internal-Hom conclusion.

theorem coefficientNormalizedTensorAssociativity
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hT : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensorCoherence l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
    (hR : CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization l E W R)
    (hF : CoefficientFiniteTensorNormalization l E W R) :
    CoefficientTensorAssociativity R.integralClosed R.systemClosed R.reduction R.reductionTensor ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, CoefficientTensorAssociativity R.integralClosed (R.finiteClosed n)
        (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E W n) (R.finiteTensor n)
